title: Agents can call agents
summary:
Agents learned to delegate, models got easier to filter, and text requests gained more knobs while community-model accounting got tidied up.

Agent runs can delegate to managed and community endpoint agents, with inherited model permissions still applying. MCP can filter model listings to agents, and a new API route lets developers register agents hosted on OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

Enter’s model catalog gained a filter for models usable with Quest Pollen, later relabeled “Hide paid.” The Pollen FAQ now explains spending and earning more clearly, and the CLI README uses the supported commands for claimed and claimable Quests.

The community catalog added vaia-ai-studio.my.id for collaborative images and StoryForge for illustrated micro-stories. Both are community-built apps.

highlights.title: Agents can delegate
highlights.text: Agent runs can call managed and community endpoint agents. MCP’s `listModels` can filter for agents, making them easier to find by canonical name. [Explore MCP tools](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Register endpoint agents
highlights.text: Register an agent hosted on an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint with `POST /account/my-models/endpoint-agents`. Registrations default to private. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Find Quest Pollen models
highlights.text: Use “Hide paid” in Enter’s model catalog to filter out paid-only models while browsing or searching. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: More simple-text controls
highlights.text: The `/text` endpoint now accepts controls including `top_p`, token limits, reasoning effort, and voice; chat responses also retain upstream choices and public extensions. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
